description: A private, offline-first voice and text journal as a progressive web app. No account, no backend, no analytics, no cloud sync — all journal content lives in the browser's IndexedDB on the user's device. Features typed entries with autosave, voice capture with transactional save, on-device Whisper transcription and Qwen reflection (optional), a self-reported feeling wheel for smartwatches (/watch/), writing mode for non-recorders, encrypted backups, and a Fable journal importer. There is no public API, no MCP server, no webhooks, and no remote access to journal content — by design.
name: Grass Journal

skills.description: Explain what Grass Journal is: a private offline-first PWA journal (typed + voice entries, on-device AI transcription/reflection, feeling-wheel mood check-ins, encrypted backups). Its core promise is 'Your thoughts stay with you' — no account, no backend, no analytics, no cloud. It is not a therapy app and makes no mental-health claims.

skills.description: State the verified platform limits: the watchOS web viewer exposes no microphone to web pages, so audio capture on Apple Watch is impossible (platform restriction, not an app bug). The feeling wheel (self-reported mood check-in) and writing mode are the watch-friendly inputs. Browser storage (IndexedDB) is durable but evictable under storage pressure — encrypted backups exist for this reason.
skills.name: Explain smartwatch limitations honestly
